findings.title: Rule: public functions must have docstring stating return or raise
findings.explanation: The public method `add_comment` has a one-line docstring that mentions the raised exception but does not state what the function returns, violating the rule that docstrings must say what they return or raise.

evidence.quote: """Add a comment to an existing ticket. Raises ValueError if it is empty or longer than MAX_COMMENT."""
Public functions have type hints and a one-line docstring that says what they return or raise.

findings.verification_note: The `add_comment` method has a one-line docstring that mentions raised ValueError but does not state the return type, violating the rule that docstrings must say what they return or raise.

findings.title: Rule: public functions must have docstring stating return or raise
findings.explanation: The public method `list_comments` has a one-line docstring that describes ordering but does not state the return value, violating the rule that docstrings must say what they return or raise.

evidence.quote: Public functions have type hints and a one-line docstring that says what they return or raise.

findings.verification_note: The `list_comments` method's docstring describes ordering but does not mention the return value, breaching the rule that public functions' docstrings must state what they return or raise.

criteria.text: Any user can add a comment to an existing ticket.
criteria.explanation: The add_comment method accepts any author string and stores the comment without permission checks, allowing any user to add a comment.

criteria.text: An empty or whitespace-only comment is rejected.
criteria.explanation: The method strips whitespace and raises ValueError when the resulting body is empty, rejecting empty or whitespace‑only comments.

criteria.text: A comment is at most 2000 characters.
criteria.explanation: MAX_COMMENT is defined as 2000 and the method raises ValueError when the comment length exceeds this limit, enforcing the maximum length.

criteria.explanation: The comments method returns comments ordered by id (ascending) via the store, which yields the oldest comments first.
